trajectory_summary: This call opens warm and stays warm throughout — the customer is pre-qualified in tone, forthcoming with detail, and cooperative through bill collection and scheduling. The rep completes the verify sequence in order and closes with a booked in-person appointment, but leaves clear value on the table: the wife-on-title disclosure is never followed up with a confirmation of her attendance, the EV/Tesla usage-growth signal is acknowledged only with a personal tangent about self-parking rather than being tied back into the pitch, and the slate-roof/ground-mount detail is filed without comment despite being directly relevant to design planning.
